data.narrative:
Newspace Research, a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Sameer Joshi, has raised $73.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparables (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $73M total raised as a proxy base, applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $139M. Peer-median analysis examines 7 same-sector, same-stage private companies with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B; the median valuation across this set is $1.0B. The public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) provide additional market reference points but are not separately weighted here due to structural differences.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $118M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $570M. The 8.9x spread reflects material dispersion within the peer set, with some peers reaching unicorn status while others cluster below $500M. Key uncertainties center on relative product maturity, customer concentration, and recurring revenue contribution within the defense sector, where stage-equivalent peers show notably divergent risk profiles. The stage-progression floor and peer-median anchor suggest fair value likely exceeds $400M, though the upper range depends critically on revenue traction and customer diversification not evident in available data.
